assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent syncope and transient episodes of cerebral ischemia, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology.
Given the known diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5).
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential bradyarrhythmias or pauses.
This diagnostic procedure is medically necessary to identify the arrhythmic cause of the patient's syncope and transient cerebral ischemia.
Supporting diagnosis codes include G45.9 and R55, consistent with the symptomatic presentation warranting telemetry monitoring.
